name: Facet
text: Choose a single high-contrast dark theme with adjustable saturation and font size. This maximizes visibility and liveliness for long screentime while keeping the interface consistent. The trade-off is reduced brand flexibility—we lose the ability to match every client’s palette—but we gain speed and clarity for our own work.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single high-contrast dark theme locks out users who need *low* contrast—like those with light sensitivity or migraines—while adjustable saturation and font size add complexity that slows screentime. Instead, let the system preference toggle auto-switch between dark and light themes based on OS settings; this keeps consistency without fragmenting the interface’s visual identity. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and comfort across contrast needs.
